interface.signature: def addBinary(A: str, B: str) -> str:

preconditions.expression: all(c in '01' for c in A) and all(c in '01' for c in B)
preconditions.description: Both input strings A and B consist exclusively of characters '0' and '1'.
Both input strings A and B have at least one character (1 ≤ |A|, |B| ≤ 10^6).

postconditions.expression: all(c in '01' for c in return_value)
postconditions.description: The output string consists exclusively of characters '0' and '1'.
The output string has no leading zeros unless the result is '0'.
The output string represents the sum of the binary values of A and B, with no leading zeros.
